newsitem.title: DENMARK: Copenhagen bourse Q2 share turnover 22 pct up y/y.
newsitem.headline: Copenhagen bourse Q2 share turnover 22 pct up y/y.

text.p: Share turnover on Copenhagen Stock Exchange rose 21.8 percent in 1997's second quarter compared to the same 1996 period to 9.1 billion ecu, according to Nordic Securities Market quarterly statistics received by Reuters on Monday.
The figure was a 19.6 percent fall on 1997's first quarter turnover, but share prices jumped by 10.5 percent during the second quarter and by 46.2 percent on an annual basis, the report said.
It said that the most traded shares on the Copenhagen Stock Exchange in 1997's second quarter in order of volume were Novo Nordisk, Sophus Berendsen, Tele Danmark and Danisco.

It said that Stockholm bourse saw a 0.3 percent turnover fall from the first to second quarter of 1997 to 36.6 billion ecu, with turnover in Helsinki down 8.8 percent at 6.8 billion ecu and Oslo 10.2 percent lower at 8.9 billion ecu on a quarterly basis.
